items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Tony told me he played with you once at a place called the House of Pleasure.

ctx.x: The Times-Pickey and New Orleans States magazine is dated February 19th, 1950, Jeff.
Yeah. Gaspar Abonnet. Is it guitar player? Tony, Tony, yeah, Gaspar Abonnet. And Tony, Tony, oh, man. I'm sorry, but...
